short_description: Digital IMAX Dome laser projection for hemispherical venues. Uses 4K laser with anamorphic dome optics for 1.43:1-capable dome presentation without 15/70 film.

default_projection.effective_resolution_label: 4K DCI digital projection with dome anamorphic/fisheye optics; no 15/70 scan-equivalent film resolution claim.
default_projection.contrast_notes: Venue-specific dome laser contrast is not publicly published; keep null until confirmed measurements or official specs are available.

known_limitations: Not a conventional cinema — requires dome-mastered content for optimal immersion; standard flat IMAX films appear distorted through dome optics
No 15/70 film scan-equivalent resolution claim; this is a digital laser dome system
PPD lower per degree than flat GT screens because resolution is spread over a 180° dome field
Non-linear pixel density from dome optics: center sharpest, extreme periphery softer
Institutional venues primarily; not part of commercial multiplex IMAX network
